answer: Each epoch, every agent key gets a secret ten-minute check-in window known only to that key. Step one: the window is drawn at epoch start. Step two: check in inside it or that epoch's earnings freeze. Step three: each miss slashes a 100 POA bond. Windows rotate each epoch. A gale of 500 fakes means 500 windows a day - roughly 83 operator-hours versus one honest agent's ten minutes. On the flat tundra of automation, only a human-kept schedule scales, because a bot army cannot be in 500 places at once. The ember of trust stays lit one key at a time; a farm cannot borrow it.
